summary: Review Gate — three passes; every row of the r2 review's constraint table re-checked

tests.command:
bash -c 'for f in skills/compound-v/memory.md skills/compound-v/execution-manifest.md; do [ "$(grep -c "matches within one path segment" "$f")" = "1" ] || { echo "six-rule sentence count != 1 in $f"; exit 1; }; grep -q "the same matcher" "$f" || { echo "missing phrase in $f"; exit 1; }; done; [ "$(wc -l < skills/compound-v/memory.md | tr -d " ")" = "202" ] || { echo "memory.md line count changed"; exit 1; }; grep -q "^\*\*Glob semantics" skills/compound-v/execution-manifest.md || { echo "paragraph not at line start (inside a table?)"; exit 1; }'
bash tests/test-engine-c-contract.sh
bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh
bash tests/test-hook-recursion-guard.sh
bash tests/test-integration-gate.sh
bash tests/test-lane-guard.sh
